description: This file provides type declarations for the `dns.promises` API in Node.js, including functions for DNS resolution, server configuration, error codes, and the `Resolver` class, enabling TypeScript type safety and autocompletion for DNS promise-based operations.

classes.name: Resolver
classes.description: An independent resolver class allowing custom DNS server configurations and DNS query operations.

methods.name: function getServers(): string[]; getServers
methods.description: Returns an array of DNS server addresses currently used for DNS resolution.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Resolves a hostname into an IPv4 or IPv6 address, or both, based on provided options.

methods.name: lookupService
methods.description: Resolves an IP address and port into a hostname and service name.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a hostname into various DNS resource records, such as A, AAAA, CNAME, etc.

methods.name: resolve4
methods.description: Resolves IPv4 addresses (A records) for a hostname.

methods.name: resolve6
methods.description: Resolves IPv6 addresses (AAAA records) for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveAny
methods.description: Resolves all DNS records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveCaa
methods.description: Resolves CAA records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveCname
methods.description: Resolves CNAME records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveMx
methods.description: Resolves MX records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveNaptr
methods.description: Resolves NAPTR records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveNs
methods.description: Resolves NS records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolvePtr
methods.description: Resolves PTR records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveSoa
methods.description: Resolves SOA records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveSrv
methods.description: Resolves SRV records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveTlsa
methods.description: Resolves TLSA records for a hostname.

methods.name: resolveTxt
methods.description: Resolves TXT records for a hostname.

methods.name: reverse
methods.description: Performs a reverse DNS lookup for an IP address.

methods.name: getDefaultResultOrder
methods.description: Gets the default result order setting for DNS lookups.

methods.name: setServers
methods.description: Sets the DNS servers to use for DNS resolution.

methods.name: setDefaultResultOrder
methods.description: Sets the default ordering of DNS lookup results.
